scores.visual_critic_note: Clean UI chrome with good typographic hierarchy and intentional blue/green accent palette, but the core visualization is clipped at the bottom and the heavy dark edge bundles overwhelm the circle-pack geometry, making the hierarchical structure hard to read.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force-layout node sizing and sunburst radial scaling; data-driven domains via d3.extent; key functions on node and link joins; no bar/area baseline issues apply — minor gap is undocumented sqrt-radial transform in partition and missing key function on hierarchy-link join.
scores.stress_test_note: Tension slider correctly uses RAF coalescing and force ticks are inherently RAF-throttled, but layout switches rely on implicit D3 transition interruption rather than explicit .interrupt() calls, and the drag behavior lacks .filter() to prevent scroll/zoom conflicts on touch devices.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view-at-a-time layout switching and edge bundling keep working memory load manageable, but 300 bundled edges form a dense dark tangle at the center of the circle pack that obscures the very hierarchy the circles express, and 6+ simultaneous controls (tension, links toggle, links-on-top, hierarchy toggle, easing, animate) compete for attention without clear visual grouping — animation/interaction quality across 8 layout transitions cannot be assessed from the static screenshot.
